title: K-flat tensor models for inverse image under a coefficient extension
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and finite extensions $E\subset L$ of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with valuation rings $\mathcal O_E\subset\mathcal O_L$ and uniformizers $\varpi_E,\varpi_L$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $g:X\to Y$ be a scheme isomorphism with $\ell$ invertible on both schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Work on the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. For $W=X,Y$ put $R_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,W}$, $S_W=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,W}$, $B_{F,W,m}=(\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^m)_W$ for $F=E,L$ and $m\geq1$, with quotient projections $\pi^F_{W,m}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $G_F=g^{-1}$ on completed-coefficient module complexes, transporting the action along the ring isomorphism $c_F:g^{-1}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,Y}\simeq\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,X}$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. These maps satisfy $\pi^F_{X,m}c_F=c^g_{\mathcal O_F/\varpi_F^m}g^{-1}(\pi^F_{Y,m})$. Tensor products below are sheaf tensor products and their total complexes [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves].

For every flat-term K-flat complex $P$ of $R_Y$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], the complex $G_EP$ is flat-term K-flat over $R_X$. The complexes $Q=P\otimes_{R_Y}S_Y$ and $Z=G_EP\otimes_{R_X}S_X$ are flat-term K-flat over $S_Y$ and $S_X$, respectively. There is a natural isomorphism of complexes of $S_X$-modules
$$b_P:Z\xrightarrow{\sim}G_LQ,$$
with local formula
$$b_P(y\otimes s)=g^{-1}(p\otimes s_0),\qquad y=g^{-1}p,\quad s=c_L(g^{-1}s_0).$$
For every $m$, the square of complexes whose horizontal maps are $b_P$ and the analogous finite-coefficient tensor comparison
$$G_E(P\otimes_{R_Y}B_{E,Y,m})\otimes_{B_{E,X,m}}B_{L,X,m}\xrightarrow{\sim}G_L(P\otimes_{R_Y}B_{L,Y,m})$$
and whose vertical maps are the coefficient quotient maps commutes; on the upper left the quotient map is $G_EP\otimes_{R_X}S_X\to G_E(P\otimes_{R_Y}B_{E,Y,m})\otimes_{B_{E,X,m}}B_{L,X,m}$. The $G_E$ notation here means the underlying inverse image with its finite coefficient action transported by $c^g_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m}$. The finite comparisons commute with the quotient transitions, using the same-index maps $\iota_m:\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m\to\mathcal O_L/\varpi_L^m$ of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension].

On the ordinary unbounded derived categories of completed-coefficient modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], set $C_WH=H\otimes^L_{R_W}S_W$. For a flat-term K-flat resolution $P\to K$, $Z$ represents $C_XG_EK$, $Q$ represents $C_YK$, and $[b_P]$ represents a natural isomorphism $b_K:C_XG_EK\xrightarrow{\sim}G_LC_YK$, independent of the resolution under the canonical K-flat comparisons. No derived completeness or constructibility of $K$ is required.
